messages:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick ask — VectorGrid sent final marketing kit for the joint solution marketplace listing. Can we do a fast brand + legal safety pass today? Uploaded files: vectorgrid_logo.svg, vectorgrid_logo_white.svg, vectorgrid_onepager_v2.pdf, vectorgrid-case-tn.pdf :file_folder:

Sasha (Design): grabbing them now. first glance: logo has tight clearspace on SVG, need a 24px min touch area for marketplace tile. white variant looks fine for dark bg.

Mike (Marketing): timeline? marketplace listing goes live Wed. Need final hero asset and the co-brand lockup by EOD tomorrow to hit that. Also, can we use the partner quote on pg1 of the one-pager? @Raj any concerns?

Raj (Legal): quick flags: partner trademarks OK but we need the trademark attribution line and partner approval on the quote. Also no customer names in case study PDF without explicit release. If quote is used, get a signed approval email. :warning:

Jen (Solutions): noted. The technical callout in the one-pager references our batch/latency numbers — can we slightly soften wording to "typical observed" to avoid guarantees? I can patch copy and re-export.

Sasha (Design): proposed small changes:
- swap out the black outline logo for the white SVG on the marketplace dark gradient
- increase clearspace to 28px on the hero lockup
- export hero as 1200x600 PNG and 1:1 1600x1600 for marketplace tile

Ana (Partnerships): added a quick mock of the hero with the new lockup — see link: https://redwood-internal.mockups/vectorgrid-hero-v1 (preview) :eyes:

Sasha (Design): mock looks good. Also added a CSS snippet for the web listing to maintain safe spacing:
```
/* vectorgrid co-brand lockup */
.lockup { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:24px; }
.lockup img.logo { height:48px; min-width:48px; }
```

Mike (Marketing): thanks — that CSS helps the frontend. On the case study thumbnail, can we crop to the customer logo + 2-line headline? keeps filesize down.

Raj (Legal): final checklist I need before sign-off:
- partner-confirmed quote (email)
- trademark attribution line inserted on one-pager footer: "VectorGrid is a registered trademark of VectorGrid, Inc."
- redwood trademark/attribution unchanged
Once those three are present I can approve.

Ana (Partnerships): @Jen can you patch copy to "typical observed" and remove customer name placeholder? @Sasha can you export the three requested hero assets and the 1:1 tile? I'll ping Partner to sign quote and trademark line.

Jen (Solutions): on it — will push revised one-pager within the hour and attach.

Sasha (Design): exporting now. Will upload: hero_1200x600.png, tile_1600x1600.png, lockup_svg_zipped. ETA ~25m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

collab-bot: Uploaded files: hero_1200x600.png, tile_1600x1600.png, lockup_assets.zip by Sasha (Design) at 1859504362

Mike (Marketing): sweet. once legal signs off I'll schedule marketplace publish and social cadence. Can someone confirm final alt text for images? we should include accessibility copy.

Sasha (Design): alt text suggestion added to folder: "VectorGrid + Redwood Inference solution: low-latency embedding search at scale."

Raj (Legal): I got partner approval on quote via email thread at 1859504375. Approving materials pending the trademark footer insertion. :white_check_mark:

Ana (Partnerships): trademark footer added to one-pager, updated PDF uploaded: vectorgrid_onepager_v3.pdf. Last step: final quick sign from Marketing to go live.

Mike (Marketing): I approve for publish. Scheduling for Wed 09:00 PT. Great teamwork :tada:
